name: zai-coding-plan-cn-multi
description: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan (CN) with multiple API keys for load distribution. Each account gets its own group. Uses the bigmodel.cn endpoint.
keyInstructions: Subscribe to the GLM Coding Plan and create API keys at the 智谱开放平台 (https://bigmodel.cn). For each account, provide the key when prompted. Keys are stored separately in VS Code's keystore.
